label: Approve deliverables
description: Always entered. Whether it parks for a person or resolves on the recommendation is the component's call, from the brief and the viewer's ask_below (feature.md §0.6) — so this file says nothing about the policy. `cut` is in must_ask: it can only be chosen by a person.

binding.text:
These are the product deliverables. Approve them, send them back, or cut the feature.

approve — UX planning starts from these deliverables.
revise — back to draft with your comments.
cut — the workflow terminates and nothing downstream is built.

The brief beside this artifact carries the recommendation and the two or three reasons that moved it. Where you override the recommendation, say why in the comments: the why is what the next reader needs.

inputs.reasons.description: Shown instead of the bare number: 0.62 tells a person nothing.

inputs.must_ask.description: Non-empty means ask regardless of score.

outputs.comments.description: Required when the person overrides the recommendation.
